dimensions.evidenceA: The oracle points to the place where dogs licked Naboth’s blood.
dimensions.evidenceB: The chariot is washed at the pool of Samaria.
dimensions.label: Place named

dimensions.evidenceA: The word joins Naboth’s blood with Ahab’s future blood.
dimensions.evidenceB: The narrator says the dogs lick Ahab’s blood according to the LORD’s word.
dimensions.label: Claim of correspondence

evidence.observation: Elijah is told to say that in the place where dogs licked Naboth’s blood, dogs will lick Ahab’s blood.
Ahab’s chariot is washed by the pool of Samaria, where the dogs lick his blood, according to the LORD’s word.

record.tension: The oracle and the narrated aftermath name different locations while the later account claims correspondence with the earlier word.
record.title: Where do dogs lick Ahab’s blood?
